meta.source: ICE Endex EUA Futures (CKZ) end-of-day settlements via Barchart historical API, locked same vintage as TTF
meta.convention: Calendar-year EUA for scenario year Y = Dec-Y settlement on lock date (standard annual carbon hedge)
meta.note: Independent of TTF — do not infer direction from the gas curve. Continuous front-month CSV on this date equals Dec-26 (79.11).

spot.note: Dec-26 EOD last = continuous carbon futures close on lock date (first curve point).

beyond_curve.note: Real-flat at Dec-2032 locked settlement. Nominal path: real × (1+inflation)^(year−2032). Same inflation convention as ttf_forward_curve.beyond_curve.
beyond_curve.inflation_rate_source: ECB ~2% target placeholder — same parameter family as TTF beyond_curve.inflation_rate; not a forecast
